Card 775 · self-check

Personalisation preview — no profile on record is the real state of this feed. The example profile below is a review affordance, not live data; the arithmetic under it is real (it filters the same 197 rows).

Track / Pipeline — the four states (card 787 ruling 2)

The routes are live, so the control is designed for the working state. On-ness is carried by ink weight over the unchanged surface and refusal by shape, so no hue is spent: red still means only “you cannot compete” and green only “verified eligibility”. Each state carries the reason string already in the shipped code.

In this static review copy the rows render state 1. There is no hydrate call in a file with a baked fixture, so per-row state cannot be known here — in production `hydrateWatchedSet` / `hydratePipelineSet` resolve and each row takes 1, 2 or 3; a failed hydrate gives 4 across the board.
